name: Mourning Marigold
source:
The player character is a knight who is instructed to go searching for a young girl who has gone missing... Marigold. Unfortunately for the player the last time Marigold was seen she was walking into the forest. The same forest that is believed to be haunted.

[From [url=https://chrismitreinot.itch.io/mourning-marigold]Itch.io[/url]]
